The '''''Contispex Crusader''''' was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] captained by [[Shyndi Oglerk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It served as a [[Rebel privateer|privateer]] ship for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
